Status.description_en:
Command execution status. Valid values:

Doing: Executing

Success: Succeeded

Failed: Failed. The system automatically retries within the timeout period. You can either wait or resend the request
Status.description_zh:
命令执行状态，取值范围：
Doing：执行中
Success：已成功
Failed：失败。超时时间内，失败会自动重试，客户可以选择继续等待或重新发起请求
